symptom: Re-running `describe page` output resets every layout-grid column to auto-fill: Rows/Columns/Weight|TabletWeight|PhoneWeight 12->-1, 4->-1, -2->-1 on Studio Pro pages (43 PedApp/TestApp documents). Describe printed `DesktopWidth: AutoFill` and no tablet/phone width for every column; check, exec and mx check all green.
cause: parseLayoutGridRows read Weight/TabletWeight/PhoneWeight with `.(int32)`, but Studio Pro stores them as int64, so every assertion missed and the width read as 0 (printed AutoFill). Separately, -2 (Studio Pro's 'Auto-fit content') had no MDL spelling at all, so even a correct read could not round-trip it.
insight: bson-numeric-width again: a narrow type assertion on a stored number fails silently to zero. A fixture scan of every (Weight, TabletWeight, PhoneWeight) tuple (all int64; values 1..12, -1, -2) gave both the width bug and the missing -2 spelling at once; the unit test replays every fixture tuple through describe -> parse -> build. Existing test page_nameless_pedapp_test asserted the buggy `DesktopWidth: AutoFill` output.
test: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_layoutgrid_weight_test.go; control: instrumented roundtrip harness shows 212 weight paths in 43 documents before, 0 after
